AREAS OF PRÁCTICE

The development and complexity of the Law matters in a globalized world makes specialization and sub-specialization of Attorneys-at-Law a “must” necessary in the several fields of Law. Under this perspective the members of CAMYA have become high-quality specialists in diverse legal areas like Civil and Commercial litigation and consultancy, Administrative litigation and consultancy, Tax and Foreign Trade litigation and consultancy, Constitutional Litigation, Strategic Administrative litigation and consultancy, Private Mediation, Corporate Governance, among others.

En CAMYA creemos que el tiempo de las personas y de las instituciones es muy valioso, por ello, estamos comprometidos en que nuestros clientes serán atendidos con diligencia y oportunidad adecuadas.

THE FIRM

CAMYA is a law firm made up of specialists in various branches of law with a successful professional trajectory of over 20 years in leading firms in Mexico. Currently, it is recognized by specialized directories such as ‘The Legal 500’ and ‘Who’s Who Legal’.

At CAMYA, our team is composed of distinguished professionals in various branches of law, bringing together a collective experience of more than two decades in leading firms in Mexico. We take pride in being recognized for our excellence and commitment in providing legal services of the highest quality.
